headline: Best Luminelle Build
title: Best Luminelle Build | Lightning Surge Support | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Luminelle is a Lightning support, and the star skill is Lightning Surge. It boosts your lightning allies, so cast it as soon as the fight starts. Then swap to a break Aniimo, and after that to your damage dealer. Swift Retreat is a backward dash that slows enemies, good as a dodge. Put points into health, since the buffs scale with it. Do you play Luminelle? Comment below!
description: Best Luminelle build in Aniimo: open with Lightning Surge, use Swift Retreat to dodge and prioritize health.
